snippet.title: Inken // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4419460/Inken

Explore mysterious office building suspended in a desolate world! Inken is a multi-genre roguelike that can be a deckbuilder, topdown shooter, auto runner, puzzler, or idle game! Knowledge is the power that can slay the gods!

Developed by
Jacob Gislason
